notes.title: Patch 1.3.0 - Game Stability and Shader Batching
notes.notes:
Greetings, mighty adventurers!



Let us speak plainly, I know there aren't that many people playing Gorgon Shield anymore - it wasn't the hit game I'd hoped it would be. This is 100% on me. This was my first attempt at making a 3D game in Godot ( and only the second 3D game I'd ever made, the first being a pretty awful marble maze game called Dark Rolls over a decade ago!) ... and I have to say I was a bit out of my depth. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44221347/cf2b239b3e7df6b7b2f543804bb7a74331ed2900.png"]

There was a real steep learning curve just in trying to make the game performant while also learning 3D modelling, texturing, lighting and the rest. Now, technically the game is 2.5D because I used 2D billboard sprites in a 3D environment, but still, you get the point...



The vast experience of my game dev has been in 2D and I think I never quite got this game right. The game since launch has been plagued by crashes, and the maddening thing is they're so inconsistent in where it happens. I could play the game for 45 minutes, no problem, another player might play for 5 minutes and crash. I found it so hard to replicate where the issues were and despite my best efforts, I just could never solve these issues.



So what's this patch for, you may ask? With the release of Godot 4.5, there's a great new error tracker built in and I've implemented that into the game - this will allow me to ( in theory ) better pinpoint where crashes might be coming from, right down to the function that called them.



If your game crashes during this patch, you can send me your crash logs to info at whiskeybarrelstudios dot com and I can use them to iron out any remaining issues. You can find these logs here:

C:\\Users\\User\\AppData\\Roaming\\GorgonShieldData\\logs



Okay, so also in this patch - batch shading improvements, so the game will load slowly the very first time you run it ( particularly noticable when you first enter the tower ) but on repeat plays, it will be smooth and fast. What this is doing is compiling, batching and caching all shaders so they don't cause jitters and stutters.



There's also a few small bugfixes in the game and some other performance improvements that came with the release of Godot 4.5. I played the game solidly for 2 hours straight yesterday with multiple runs, getting all the way to the mid 40s tower levels several times - not a single crash. That's not to say the game will never crash, I just hope it should be less frequent for players.



I've capped the framerate to 60fps and removed the unlimited FPS option because I think that has been causing some real weirdness.



Thanks so much to all those who played and enjoyed this game despite its flaws and issues - it was made at a very difficult time in my life personally and it was just a bit of a labyrinthine hell to get launched. I think at the heart of it, there's still a good game in there for those who are patient and brave (haha) - and having played it again extensively yesterday, I'm actually proud of it despite its flaws.



Cheers all, Oliver Joyce

Whiskeybarrel Studios

notes.title: Improved performance! No more framerate stutters! Version 1.2.4 is here.
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers!

It's been a while since the last Gorgon Shield update. With the game now fully feature complete, the only planned updates were performance related. I'd been waiting for the new update of the Godot Engine to drop, and today version 4.4 went live.

Why is this important to Gorgon Shield? Godot 4.4 included a powerful new feature, the ubershader which dramatically improves shader caching in games, and by extension, in-game performance.

What this means is that there will be no more frame stutters at the start of levels or during certain particle effects. The game will now run much smoother and the play experience should be improved.

The tradeoff of this new ubershader is that there are noticably longer loading times the first time the game is loaded while the game caches all shaders and particles to memory. On repeat plays you will find load times are a lot faster.

I have had to temporarily disable in-game leaderboards just while I sort out a bug with Godot's Steam leaderboards API - I didn't want to delay this update just for that. They will return when I find a fix!

I just wanted to send out a heartfelt thanks to everyone who played and reviewed this game. It's pretty clear the game was not , unfortunately, a big hit. That's okay though. Not every game can be , it's an ultra competitive field out there! I set out to make a unique game that was dear to me, to recreate the arcade RPGs of my youth , and playing the game many months later, I think I succeeded for the most part.

There's always stuff that could be improved and expanded upon, and if the game had sold well, I definitely had plans for it. At some point though, there's the sunk cost, and also the feeling of 'This game's story is complete, and I'm okay with that.'

I'm very proud of what I was able to accomplish with Gorgon Shield in what was personally the most difficulty year of my life, and I want to thank you again for being part of the journey to ancient myth and legend!

Cheers, Oliver Joyce
Whiskeybarrel Studios

notes.title: Rolling Patch Notes
notes.notes:
After several weeks of daily hotfixes and patches, I feel like the game is in a really stable place right now at version 1.2. If more issues / balancing is needed, I'll update the patch notes here for players.

Thank you for enjoying Gorgon Shield, for all your positive reviws, and most of all for your patience while I ironed out the bugs!

v 1.2.0.0:
⦁ Fixed missing achievements for winning the game with Rogues and Valkyries and doing 1000 points of damage
⦁ Fixed bug where slowed enemies did not take critical hit damage

v 1.1.11
⦁ Improved framerate performance of sky shader on title screen
⦁ Removed 'Shield take no damage' quest if party has 4 heroes
⦁ Added 'Loot' icon on character portraits in the Tower Shops. This little blue icon will show you how many loot items each hero has.
⦁ Increased maximum stat caps for all stats from 30 to 40
⦁ Removed 'Power' upgrade on Haste power as it does nothing.

v 1.1.9 - 1.1.10
⦁ Added multiple windowed screen resolution options
⦁ Heroes now get new loot options every time they level up
⦁ Improved sky shader performance during tower runs 
⦁ Fixed a bug where high level loot prefixes could crash the game
⦁ Updated Labyrinth Map 6 and 13 to add missing dungeon keys
⦁ Improved game translations

v 1.1.6 - 1.1.8:
⦁ Fixed MAJOR issue with lighting in the game ( blue sky not appearing, tower lighting looking all wrong etc)!
⦁ Fixed a bug where the Rune Panel on Boss Levels could get stuck in an infinite loop under certain conditions
⦁ Fixed a bug where the Loot Panel when levelling up could cause the game to unpause
⦁ Fixed a bug where the game could stall after closing the Loot panel
⦁ Fixed a bug where characters could not be selected on the Choose Equipment Screen
⦁ Fixed a level freeze bug
⦁ Changed Stun Effect on the shield as the old effect was potentially crashing some machines.
⦁ If you reach the Tower Guardian Level with "Labyrinths Off" setting, you will now gain a free level up before the fight
⦁ Updated Godot version to 4.3RC2, this should improve stability
⦁ Improved game translations

v 1.1.3-1.1.5:

 New Graphics option to limit FPS to 60fps or unlimited. (60fs will be on by default)
 Any runes gained on a tower run will now be recovered if your game crashes during the run
 Traps now do less damage in the Labyrinth
 Finding the exit in a Labyrinth now triggers an automatic free Level Up for one of your herores
 Improved text translations
 Updated build of Godot Engine to 4.3RC2


v 1.1.2

 Heroes can now be named! These names are attached to a hero colour. So if you name your green hero "Conan", all future green heroes will be known as Conan until you change it or reset the hero names.
 Improved performance and stability ( more potential crash fixes!)
 Fixed a bug where you would go straight to the Labyrinth from any prison, even if you were nowhere near the Tower Guardian
 Fixed a bug where no matter what tower you clicked, the left tower would fall
 Improved text translations


v 1.1.0

 MAJOR -  If your game crashes during a run, when you next reload the game, you will receive all the gold you lost during the run
 Loot quality now scales with the TOWER LEVEL instead of your heroes' character levels. This means low level heroes can still find great gear higher in the tower.
 If you kill a monster with 1 second left on the clock, no XP will be gained (was causing some issues)
 Fixed some text bugs and improved game stability


Updates v 1.0.3
 Removed 60FPS frame rate cap
 Added an option in the Settings / Gameplay tab to skip Labyrinths if the player wishes to
 Sound now turns off when you minimize the game window
 Translation updates
Fixes
 MAJOR - Fixed a crash where your fourth hero (Yellow) would not attack, and cause a crash
 Fixed a bug where the game could stall if the Quest Reward Panel appeared when you were levelling up
 Fixed a bug where hero positions could glitch out when new heroes joined the party during the run 
 Fixed a bug where the game could stall if the Quest Reward Panel appeared when you were levelling up

Changes
 Increased maximum character level to 99
 Unlocked the Prison option on the doorway levels 
 Removed heroes joining the run when you first unlock slots - this is causing some crashes I suspect. You will now unlock a second slot, and on your next run, you can choose two heroes. (Then 3 at level 14, And 4 at level 24)
 Add a slight delay before allowing input when levelling up so you don't accidentally choose the wrong hero to level up
 Minor balancing

WIP- some fixes to address game crashes, this may take a little while as l'm not quite sure what's causing them. 

Thank you for all your reports!

notes.title: V 0.7.0 - The Endlessly Replayable Patch!
notes.notes:
Forget everything you thought you knew about Gorgon Shield! ( Which admittedly wouldn't be much as not many you have played the demo yet. ). Everything changes in this major patch.

Just in time for the big Steam Endlessly Replayable Festival, the new v0.7.0 update brings a ton of sweeping changes and improvements to the game. From the pacing of tower levels, to the displaying of stats, to UI improvements, this version of the game is very close in look at feel to what we'll see in the big July launch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44221347/f8ac76509977d5682230aae44d76d639db00c8bd.gif

With just a few months until launch, the game is very nearly complete. From here on in, its all about balancing, bugfixing, improving systems and of course adding in the remaining tower sections 'Ramparts', 'Arena' and 'Pipes'. 

Please hit me up with feedback about the game and be sure to wishlist it - I need all the numbers I can get at this stage!

Cheers, Oliver Joyce
Whiskeybarrel Studios

Full change list for v0.7.0


 Each level now lasts for 30 seconds, up from 20
 Hero Slot unlock levels have been changed to 8 (2 heroes) 16 (3 heroes) and 24 ( 4 heroes , not in demo )
 The Wizard is now available as soon as you unlock the second hero slot in the tower ( and appears again for the fourth slot )
 First hero is now FREE when you unlock the tavern
 Completely redesigned the Forked Path screen to show the player useful information
 Monster Cards now appear on each level to show you enemy monster stats
 Level Up screen has been redesigned - power deck has been removed
 Monsters now have different spawn rates and movement speeds
 Removed LUCK, MELEE RADIUS and RANGED RADIUS as stats in the game.
 Improved tutorial with guiding arrows and more information
 Better randomization of Tower Forked Paths
 Added Japanese Language Support
 Improved visuals on Gorgon Shield's damage circle, lens flare layer, particles etc
 Fixed a bug where ranged projectiles exploded before reaching their target
 Fixed hit area on Tower button in Destinations Menu
 Added animation tweens to many game panels
 Heaps of other random things I've forgotten to document here in the patch notes!

notes.title: Patch v0.5.1 Notes
notes.notes:
v 0.5.1.0:

⦁ End game 'wishlist' screen appears less frequently so you can get back into the action faster
⦁ Ranged Damage is now tied to Intellect
⦁ Ranged Attack Radius is now tied to Strength
⦁ Fixed a bug where Lightning Bolt and other attack powers had a long duration (instead of instant) which led to longer cooldown times
⦁ Fixd a bug showing incorrect cooldown times on Special Powers
⦁ Tower: Fixed a bug where the shield's power bar went offscreen during boss fights
⦁ Tower: Fixed a bug where Grim Bargain did not grant the proper reward to a hero
⦁ Labyrinth: Delayed monster spawning for first few seconds of being in the labyrinth
⦁ Labyrinth: Reduced damage taken from labyrinth dungeon traps to make them fairer
⦁ Labyrinth: Enemies don't start spawning from traps until a few seconds has passed
⦁ Improved cache loading times at start of game to hopefully stop some older machines freezing up on first load.

notes.title: Demo Version 0.5 is LIVE with massive changes. You gotta check this out!
notes.notes:
"This is madness.... this is V0.5 of GORGON SHIELD!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44221347/f8ac76509977d5682230aae44d76d639db00c8bd.gif

Greetings, brave heroes! Been a few months since the first demo for Gorgon Shield went up, and I got a ton of really useful feedback from you guys - so firstly, you have my thanks. At the start of the year, I decided I needed to bite the bullet and redo some of the systems that just weren't working in the game to make it feel more dynamic, more strategic, basically more engaging.

So, here's what's new in the latest version of the game. The MAJOR addition is the new labyrinth mode, a full 'Gauntlet 2' style dungeon to explore behind some of the tower's doors. There's also a totally reworked levelling up and power system - meaning you get a LOT more control over your heroes development. Want a Barbarian specialising in hamstringing your enemies, and another with the Berserk power? Or two wizards, one with lighting, one with fire? Now you can.

Oh yeah, and there's a full loot system in the game. Magic rings, gauntlets, capes and more.

I'd love for you to check out this new version of the game and give me more invaluable feedback. The game's scheduled to launch this July and I've still got a lot more systems, minigames and additions to add. "This is but a taste of the terror Medusa will unleash!" (to paraphrase Gandalf!) 

Cheers , Oliver Joyce
Whiskeybarrel Studios

Patch notes for V0.5.0


 Added labyrinth levels to game! Use ARROW KEYS to move around the labyrinth and find the exit.
Tower content is now randomised, from background wall textures to door options
 Total overhaul of levelling up system introducing loot, cards and more
 New customizable character power system. Characters start off with no powers and can learn as they go.
 Added many new graphics and game option settings, including difficulty level
 Removed Tower Level selection screen
 Added Medusa taunting screen between certain areas
 Enemies now fall off platforms when killed, unless by a critical hit, then it's a splat
 Added new death animation bounce to heroes
 Improved textures in the tower
 Many new visual FX from tilt shift to lens flares and tower exterior backgrounds.
⦁ New arcade cabinet in game over
 Many bugfixes and balance changes
 Set demo level cap to 20
 A billion other things!

notes.title: Version 0.4.0 - New, streamlined minimal UI! Plus, pooled party gold!
notes.notes:
Greetings, mighty heroes! Welcome to patch 0.4.0 of the demo. Check it out, I'd love your feedback on the game so far!

Cheers, Oliver Joyce
Whiskeybarrel Studios

V 0.4.0.1 Patch Notes

 New optional Battle UI options to choose from at the Graphics settings panel. You can now select a 'minimal' panel that shows a compact, minimal panel over your characters and hides the large panel at the top. You can even select both at the same time!
 Gold is now POOLED between the whole party. No longer counting individual gold tallies means you can choose any hero to buy items while you are at shops.
 Switched Green and Red hero positions around so green hero is first selected.
 Fixed a bug where runes were destroyed when removed from the shield
 Character grid now shows heroes in columns of 3 rather than 4 (to match the fact there are 9 total)
 Improved texture on shield pylon and brightness on Shield damage texture
 Fixed a bug where the tower tutorial could be reactivated accidentally from the Select Tower Level menu
 Defeating bosses now grants the party bonus gold
 Increased base melee damage of all characters
